JNJ.headline: JNJ in strong uptrend with positive EMA opinion and solid earnings, near 52-week high.
JNJ.technical_summary: Price above all key EMAs (10W,20W,40W) and daily EMAs, VStop up for 6 weeks, net volume positive (35.7%), Mansfield RS positive across all timeframes. Volume in-line but not spiking, RSI moderate (daily 62.7, weekly 65.2). Strong uptrend with no technical deterioration.
JNJ.catalyst_summary: Positive EMA panel opinion for plaque psoriasis pill Icotyde (July 24, 2026) and Q2 2026 adjusted sales growth of 5.7% to $25.3B with EPS $2.90, providing fundamental support.
JNJ.actionable_take: Accumulate on pullbacks to the 255-260 zone (near 10 DEMA and prior support). Use VStop at 242.5 as a trailing stop. Maintain position as long as price holds above 40 WEMA (225) and VStop remains up. Consider partial profit-taking near 52-week high of 269.4 if momentum stalls.
JNJ.news_used:
*   **JNJ** -- Plaque psoriasis pill Icotyde received a positive opinion from the European Medicines Agency's expert panel on July 24, 2026.
*   **JNJ** -- Reported Q2 2026 adjusted sales grew 5.7% to $25.3 billion with adjusted earnings of $2.90 per share.
